feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 October 2026 5:27pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 20 October 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

A slow-moving upper low near Ireland is maintaining unstable conditions across the British Isles, with frontal systems bringing cloud, rain, and increasing winds.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the northeast and far west of the area at first, becoming variable 3 or less in places this evening, then increasing northwest 5 to 7 late tonight and tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow morning, occasionally rough in the south tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing tonight, then further rain spreads from the west later in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, soon decreasing west or northwest 4 to 6 tomorrow evening, then gradually west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight. Veering south Thursday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Showers, mainly overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
